---
title: "Communication and remote calls"
---

*Sample chapter for the proposed course plan.*

## Learning outcome

Explain why retrying a remote request can duplicate an effect.

**Prerequisites:** Lectures 01–02.

## Core idea

A remote call can complete even when its response never reaches the caller. Retrying a state-changing operation can repeat its effect unless the receiver detects duplicate requests or the operation is idempotent.

## Worked scenario

A client sends the same registration request twice using one request identifier. The service stores that identifier with the result and returns the stored result for a duplicate.

## Discussion

What must be stored atomically to avoid a duplicate registration after a crash?

## Recap

A retry policy needs an explicit strategy for duplicate effects.
